CustomMetadata.label: Volunteer hours: household, job from shift, and the approval default

values.value: Fills in the household from the person so household totals are one rollup (R-VG2), fills the job in from the shift (R-VG3), and sets the starting status from the Hours Require Approval setting (R-VG6). Switching it off leaves the household empty, which leaves those hours out of the household total until the entry is saved again.
